pages.text: [#](53341a)Begin with a **brim-full**, heated cauldron and a finished effect or world action. Sneak-use **Tongue of Dog** on the vessel to release the brew without bottling it. A valid altar within eight blocks must pay the full ritual power cost.[#]()
pages.title: Casting from the Cauldron

pages.text: [#](53341a)Delivery is checked before power is spent. A ritual that lacks a valid target, cannot place its gas or liquid, or conflicts with its dispersal remains in the bowl so you can correct the working.[#]()
[#](53341a)Chalk-circle rites are catalogued separately in the Witches' Primer under **Circle Magic & Rites**, with every exact offering and ring.[#]()

[#](53341a)Misfortune is tested only after a powered ritual succeeds. Casting without a complete small or medium ritual circle adds risk; Infernal circles and the Shade of Leonard add further risk. Backfire may bring Slowness, Paralysis, Insanity, or lightning.[#]()
pages.title: Risk

pages.text: [#](53341a)A successful release empties the cauldron. Protective Hunter clothing, Area Markers, and Voodoo Protection Poppets may still intercept hostile target workings.[#]()
